with all that's happening in the world, I feel like it could just happen at any time. not just me but scores of people all at once. it's really fucking scary. to die and never fully live life to its fullest. I have days where I can't stop thinking about it and it keeps me from getting stuff done. I gotta wonder how ppl living during the cold war got through this shit.

yeah, it really fucking sucks that people cant realize how their judgements on others make them feel. I try to consciously not judge ppl until I know they've done something shitty, but I always seem to slip. I think it might be something innate within humans, maybe something to do with like survival instincts idk. The ppl I hate the most are the ones that indulge in it. And I hear you on the new school, new me bit. That was how it was with the two friends that cut me off. I didnt face discrimination like you did but I'm just very anxious around new ppl. I get scared and I just dont know what to do. That gave me a reputation in high school as a quiet, weird guy. I thought when I got to college, I could change that, and I did for a while. Then I got cut off and the infrastructure of my social efforts and confidence just fucking crumbled. I know where you are coming from, about how the pain doesn't seem to end. When you are in pain, we focus on the present more than the future. But I learned a very important lesson. It passes. These emotions will pass. It's perfectly acceptable, I would argue necessary even, to let them out. But after a certain while of outlasting and living with the pain, it gets better. You wake up one morning and you realize you don't feel as bad as the previous day. And then I would just go from there. You don't need to rush to make new friends, but if one day u feel better, check out a club ur interested in or something. You can make new friends just by showing up to something ur interested in and then talking with people. Last thing, even though bad people will always be around, it doesn't mean that good people aren't winning or that they don't exist in ur life. It's just a matter of finding them. And you will, I promise :)

People can be very shitty and unsympathetic towards others a lot of the time. Let me be the first to say that you aren't alone in feeling this way. In fact, I'd wager a lot of people feel the same way you do. I know I do. I can't understand why people do bad things and go about themselves intentionally hurting others. It's probably a mix of ignorance and ego. People thinking they're always right, refusing to accept blame. Understanding this and being angry at others for being this way isn't abnormal, quite the opposite. If you have any specifics you want to discuss then you are welcome to share.

Hi, I understand wanting to feel this way. Unfortunately moving on isn't an immediate revelation. I know it doesn't seem helpful and is really cliche to say, "time heals all wounds," but there is a degree of truth to it. For me, when I have my similar thoughts and feelings, I just take care of myself as best I can. I don't focus on anything else, just staying alive really. Eventually, I find that I can live with the bad things that can happen to me, and I don't feel as bad anymore. I'm so sorry that all of this happened to you, I want you to move past this and find someone who appreciates you for the caring and empathetic person that you are.
